messages:
Maria: Quick Day 4 async standup — what I did: synced repos, ran unit tests, opened PR #342.
Maria: Blockers: can't SSH to dev box (Permission denied), VPN drops intermittently at office, Docker Desktop crashes after mac update.
Maria: Today: unblock SSH + VPN, get CI green on my PR, pair with Jonathan on infra onboarding.
Jonathan: @Maria I'll re-check your SSH key on the dev host. Can you paste output of `ssh -v git@redwood-dev` and macOS version?
Maria: macOS 13.5. `ssh -v` shows: "debug1: Offering public key: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519" then "Permission denied (publickey)".
InfraBot: Created ticket INFRA-579 to sync SSH keys and check auth logs. Assigned to Jonathan. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-579
Dev Oncall: Quick tip — if you regenerated keys, run `eval $(ssh-agent -s)` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and retry.
Maria: I tried `ssh-add` (agent running) — still permission denied. Jonathan said he'll check server auth logs.
Elena: Re: VPN, same flaky behavior reported on 3rd floor yesterday. Vendor suggested disabling 'Always-on' in the VPN profile as a temporary workaround.
Maria: Docker: `docker run hello-world` fails, daemon won't start. Logs show com.docker.backend errors.
Jonathan: If you have time in ~30m I can screenshare and debug. Otherwise paste `tail -n 200 /var/log/docker.log` here.
Maria: Free in 30m, screenshare works. Also pinging @Elena for a quick review on my PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/342
Elena: On it — will review after standup. :thumbsup:
InfraBot: Reminder — New hire checklist item 'Workstation security patch' pending for Maria. Assigned to People Ops.
Jonathan: FYI mac test in CI is flaky right now; if your PR shows an unrelated failure we can re-run.
Maria: Update: screenshare done, Jonathan fixed SSH key on server, disabled always-on VPN setting fixed drops. Docker daemon still flaky; filing a ticket with eng-infra.
Maria: Current status: SSH + VPN unblocked. Blocking: docker daemon crash. Next: attach docker logs to infra ticket, re-run CI, and follow up on PR review.
Maria: Thanks everyone — will post final status once Docker ticket has updates. :coffee:
